Name: SummerVacation
Overview:
The beach is the same as always, yet somehow different. Star fragments fall on the sand. You collect the mysteriously shining fragments with fervor. That's the summer you remember.

Control Natsuki, who gets lost on the mysterious star-covered beach. Push blocks and use items to collect three star fragments to clear the level.

Use the hammer to break rocks. Use the shovel to dig holes. Use the swim ring to cross water.

Be careful of enemies as you challenge yourself through all 30 stages!

A fun, summer-filled puzzle game.
